questions.question: Dr. Hachimi needs to organize his team. According to best practices, what is the ideal composition for a high-performing dental practice team?
options: A single assistant who does everything
A practitioner, an assistant, a secretary
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'A balanced team allows for efficient task distribution and better quality of care.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui wants to optimize supply management. What is the recommended method to avoid stock shortages?
options: Buy in bulk once a year
Follow a minimum stock system with regular orders
Only order when stock is at zero
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'A minimum stock system prevents shortages and overstocking.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi must choose a practice management system. What is the most important criterion for management software?
options: Its compatibility with the practice's needs
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'Software must adapt to the specific needs of the practice to be effective.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui wants to improve patient reception. According to best practices, what element is essential for a good welcome?
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'The welcome reflects the practice. Trained staff create a positive first impression.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi must establish a work schedule. What is the most effective method to avoid scheduling conflicts?
options: A shared schedule validated by the team
A schedule modified at the last minute
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'A shared schedule allows everyone to organize themselves and reduces conflicts.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui must manage a conflict between two assistants. What is the first step to take?
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'Individual listening allows understanding the causes of the conflict before finding a solution.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi wants to improve patient loyalty. What strategy is the most effective?
options: Do not contact patients between appointments
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'Personalized follow-up shows the patient that they are important to the practice.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui wants to organize a weekly team meeting. What is the ideal duration to maintain attention?
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'A short and effective meeting maintains attention and addresses essential points.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi must choose his suppliers. What criterion is a priority in choosing a supplier?
options: The proximity of the head office
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'Quality and reliability are essential to ensure continuity of care.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui must manage the practice's phone calls. What is the good practice for answering effectively?
options: Introduce yourself and offer your help
Only answer at the end of the day
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'A professional telephone reception strengthens the practice's image.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi wants to install an online appointment booking system. What is the main advantage?
options: Offer flexibility and autonomy to patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'Patients appreciate the flexibility and autonomy of booking their appointments online.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui must develop a continuing education plan for the team. What is the recommended frequency?
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'Regular continuing education keeps the team up-to-date and motivated.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi must manage workplace stress. What is the best strategy to prevent team burnout?
options: Establish moments of exchange and relaxation
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'Moments of exchange and relaxation strengthen team cohesion and prevent burnout.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui must manage patient complaints. What is the right attitude to adopt?
options: Listen actively and propose a solution
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'Active listening and proposing solutions turn a complaint into a loyalty opportunity.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi wants to improve internal communication. What is the most effective tool for a practice team?
options: A communication log or a shared digital tool
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'A shared tool allows clear and traceable communication between all team members.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui must set objectives for the year. What method is recommended for setting achievable objectives?
options: SMART objectives (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Realistic, Time-bound)
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'SMART objectives help clarify expectations and measure progress.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi must manage team leave. What is the best practice?
options: Grant leave at the last minute
Plan leave in advance with the team
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'Advance planning of leave avoids tensions and ensures continuity of service.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui wants to evaluate team performance. What method is the most appropriate?
options: An evaluation based solely on turnover
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'Regular feedback enables continuous improvement and strengthens motivation.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi must manage an unhappy patient on social media. What is the right reaction?
options: Respond publicly in a professional manner and offer private contact
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'A professional public response shows that the practice takes opinions seriously.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui wants to develop the practice's online presence. What is the most important element?
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'A modern website is the practice's showcase and the first impression for new patients.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi must manage a theft in the practice. What is the first action to take?
options: Secure the premises and notify the authorities
Accuse the first patient who comes
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'The safety of people and property is paramount. The authorities must be notified.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui wants to set up a loyalty program. What offer is most attractive to patients?
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'Personalized follow-up shows the patient that they are unique and important to the practice.'

questions.question: Dr. Hachimi must manage an emergency patient. What is the absolute priority?
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'Patient safety and well-being are always the absolute priority.'

questions.question: Dr. Chaoui must train a new assistant. What is the most effective method?
options: Give them a manual to read alone
questions.explanation: Dr. Hachimi explains: 'Mentoring allows for progressive and secure learning.'

questions.question: After several months, Dr. Hachimi notices a significant improvement in his practice. Dr. Chaoui congratulates him: 'You are starting to really master the organization!' What is the next step for Dr. Hachimi?
options: Delegate more and focus on care
questions.explanation: Dr. Chaoui explains: 'Delegation allows the practitioner to focus on what matters: care and patient relationships.'
